flow_summary: The interview follows a mostly logical sequence with one question at a time and appropriate follow-ups on details like medication dose and duration. However, it fails to pursue the vague name response, misclassifies a clearly past medication as current (asking dose/side effects after "I was on one before"), and omits any safety response despite PHQ-9 Q9 > 0 with documented current passive risk.
